portfolio.name: Ember A.
aboutParagraphsHtml: Hiii! I specialize in any-stack development. I build across mobile, backend, desktop, and game server environments.
With a decade+ of experience in the industry, I've contributed to projects from B2B software to indie games.
When I'm not working or studying, I'm grinding my projects, my lofi, or gaming. All live as loafykitten!

projects.title: projects
projects.description: Featured projects by Ember — real-time speech detection, game modding, and web frameworks.
projects.introHtml: A curated selection of my most notable work. For the full catalog, see my GitHub.

entries.name: Swear Jar
entries.tagline: Real-Time Speech Detection + Live Web Widget
entries.descriptionHtml: Two-component system: a web service with API and WebSocket broadcasting for a live widget, paired with a Python speech detection client powered by Whisper. Pipeline flows from audio capture through Whisper transcription, profanity detection, API event dispatch, WebSocket broadcast, to live UI update.

entries.name: Elden Ring: Classes Expanded
entries.tagline: Game Modification for AAA FromSoftware Title
entries.descriptionHtml: Reverse-engineered game architecture to create custom weapon variants and a modular mod structure using Mod Engine 3. Features two original character archetypes — Abysswalker and Bestia — each with unique starting builds and equipment.

entries.name: Transgress
entries.tagline: TypeScript-First Web Server Framework for Bun
entries.descriptionHtml: HTTP routing, middleware pipeline, custom logger, WebSocket support, and HTML templating. Published as @loafykitten/transgress on npm. A learning project exploring web framework fundamentals from the ground up.
